input.explanation: No code outside this repository has to change. In src/io_shop/purchase_ledger.py, `record_purchase_deriving_the_month` now writes `total_this_month_cents` on every write, so either path that `record_a_purchase` picks leaves the month total matching the purchases. Two things still need people rather than code. The branch that 26f1d7e2 was deployed from is not in main, so it has to take this change before it is deployed again. And someone has to run scripts/repair_monthly_totals.py, which has not been run, against an export of the accounts and load the corrected records back. Both are deploy and operations steps; neither is a code change somewhere else.
